title: consumable stars
description: recipes that add consumable nether stars that give powerful effects when eaten
body:
this datapack offers 4 crafting recipes that create alternate nether stars, each of these stars will give rare and powerful effects when consumed that last 1 hour each, these include:
- haste 2
- luck 5
- conduit power
- dolphins grace

the zip file also contains an optional addon that can be extracted and added next to this datapack, this datapack will add a 5th nether star recipe that gives a haste effect powerful enough to instamine deepslate

you can have these recipes added to the recipe book by having a nether star in your inventory
